title: •Bravo Fighter
caption: •Bravo Fighter (V)
game_text: May add 1 astromech. During battle, may target a starship with no character piloting. Draw destiny. If destiny > defense value, target hit. Permanent pilot provides ability of 4. Immune to attrition < 3.
game_text_lines:
May add 1 astromech. During battle, may target a
starship with no character piloting. Draw destiny.
If destiny > defense value, target hit. Permanent
pilot provides ability of 4. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Flown by an unknown pilot who likes to spin a lot. Played the deciding role in the attack against the Droid Control Ship.

notes: Group: Everything Else. Bottom-half slip. Unique. Banner STARFIGHTER: N-1 STARFIGHTER; POWER 3 / MANEUVER 5 / HYPERSPEED 3; deploy 3 / forfeit 4; no scomp ring (none on the printed card either). Icon column top to bottom: square lavender Republic tile, Rebel pilot helmet on yellow (permanent pilot), astromech dome on red (nav); then VS16 sphere. Credits under the text box: 'Original concept by Brian Terwilliger' / 'Syracuse V-Lite 2005'. CHANGES vs printed Bravo Fighter (Theed Palace): POWER 2 → 3, MANEUVER 4 → 5, deploy 2 → 3, forfeit 3 → 4; text replaced (printed: 'Permanent pilot provides ability of 3. During your control phase, if landed aboard Blockade Flagship, may draw one destiny. If destiny > 6, place Bravo Fighter in your Used Pile; Flagship ‘blown away.’'); the printed column's middle icon is a different (Episode I-era) pilot face, the slip prints the classic Rebel helmet. Printed card carries the Theed Palace ring plus the Episode I icon → ring_icons ['episode1']. Lore matches the wiki and the V0 745 px remake. Copyright © 2001 line legible on V0-L-bravofighter.gif. Modern: V0-L-bravofighter.gif (745, Virtual Set 0 remake, same art; its text is a later rewrite) used for art; VB5-L-bravofighter-pre.gif (350, Virtual Block 5) also downloaded. Slip text matches the stub.
